cost.basis: hermetic: provider keys stripped, keyword search only, scripted chronicle judge; no model and no paid request

delivered_tokens.basis: hermetic: provider keys stripped, keyword search only, scripted chronicle judge; no model and no paid request

resolved_config.caller: operation handlers with OperationContext { remote: false, sourceId: default }
resolved_config.search_path: query operation, expand=false, autocut=false, adaptive_return=false, limit=100; no embedding gateway (keyword only); search.mcp_keyword_only=true

oracle.asof: ForwardJobState over the person's events in valid-time order (eval/generators/job-state.ts)
oracle.recorded_asof: the same machine over events recorded on or before the query date
oracle.sets: set arithmetic over the ledger's timeline rows, notes, trajectory points
oracle.effective_date: independent implementation of the documented precedence chain (src/core/effective-date.ts header)
oracle.time_zone: independent US Eastern DST rule (second Sunday of March to first Sunday of November, 02:00 local)
oracle.clock_relative: pages dated anchor minus N days; windows at least two days from every page

resolved_config.targets: every metric exact: as-of accuracies 1, range set-F1 1, last-seen MAE 0 days and exact rate 1, every feature pass rate 1

presence.name: keyword index finds each tz page by token (no date bounds)

unsupported.reason: resolveDateBoundary (src/core/search/date-bounds.ts) reads Date.now() and no operation parameter pins the reference time. Relative durations are measured instead on clock-relative pages dated from the run date, outside the ledger fingerprint.

unsupported.feature: natural-language relative dates in search date bounds ("yesterday", "last week", "3 days ago")
unsupported.reason: not in the documented contract (ISO-8601 or a duration like 7d, 2w, 1m, 1y); probed as inputs that must be rejected.
search declares no since/until parameters; date bounds live on the `query` operation, which the probes call with expansion off on the keyword path.
reachable only through think, which calls a chat model.

unsupported.feature: chronicle event extraction from meeting prose
unsupported.reason: the chronicle_extract judge is a chat model. Events enter through runChronicleExtract's judge parameter (the seam gbrain's own src/eval/chronicle/harness.ts uses), so the event pages, projection, day mapping and reads are gbrain code but extraction from text is not measured.
ontology_get and chronicle_last_seen take a YYYY-MM-DD asof; instants inside a day are not addressable.
chronicle_on_this_day and chronicle_last_seen default to the database clock; probes always pass date/asof so results are reproducible.

rows.scenario: date-only is a UTC calendar date even with brain.timezone

Invalid since value "3 days ago" — expected ISO-8601 (YYYY-MM-DD or timestamp) or a relative duration like '7d', '2w', '1y'.
